EDPY 333.description: Basic course designed to familiarize the prospective teacher with the patterns of social, emotional, physical, and intellectual growth of the individual. Development of these growth patterns from the prenatal stage to the onset of adolescence.
EDPY 333.subject: EDPY
EDPY 333.title: Introduction to Child Growth and Development

EDPY 334.description: Basic course designed to familiarize the prospective junior and senior high school teacher with the pattern of social, emotional, physical, and intellectual growth of the individual during his adolescent years. Recommendation of the advisor(s) required.
EDPY 334.subject: EDPY
EDPY 334.title: Introduction to Adolescent Growth and Development

EDPY 335.description: Applications of the psychology of learning and development. Special attention to basic statistics and the behavior of the school child.
EDPY 335.subject: EDPY
EDPY 335.title: Introduction to Educational Psychology

EDPY 336.description: Foundational concepts and patterns in physical, cognitive, social, emotional, and behavioral development across childhood and adolescence. Application of this developmental knowledge to learning situations suitable to various developmental stages.
EDPY 336.subject: EDPY
EDPY 336.title: Child and Adolescent Development

EDPY 399.description: Contract approved by instructor, advisor, and department chair is required for undergraduate students.
EDPY 399.subject: EDPY
EDPY 399.title: Independent Study

EDPY 401.description: Overview of psychological theories and research as it applies to education, including theories of learning, child and adolescent development, cognitive processes, classroom practices, individual differences/student diversity, and motivation.
EDPY 401.subject: EDPY
EDPY 401.title: Learners and the Diversity of Learning

EDPY 401P.description: Field experience integrated with course on lifespan development and learning with an emphasis on individual and group diversity.
EDPY 401P.subject: EDPY
EDPY 401P.title: Practicum: Learners and the Diversity of Learning

EDPY 644.description: Examines free-choice (or informal) learning and the characteristics of settings and activities outside of formal schooling that effectively promote learning and development.
EDPY 644.subject: EDPY
EDPY 644.title: Free-Choice Learning and Informal Learning Environments

EDPY 704.description: Introduction to current issues in educational psychology. Topics include, but are not limited to: learning and teaching, cognition, developmental theories, the brain, information processing, motivation, individual differences, and the social contexts of learning.
EDPY 704.subject: EDPY
EDPY 704.title: The Field of Educational Psychology

EDPY 705.description: Overview of the contributions of the biological and social sciences to an understanding of the mental, emotional, social, and physical development from infancy through adulthood. Study of behavior problems.
EDPY 705.subject: EDPY
EDPY 705.title: Human Growth and Development

EDPY 706.description: Presentation of theories and principles of human development that are particularly relevant to teaching. Application of such theories and principles to learning situations suitable to various age and grade levels.
EDPY 706.subject: EDPY
EDPY 706.title: Growth and Development: Childhood

EDPY 707.description: A review of the literature concerning adolescence; nine years through teens. Emphasis on application to the educational setting.
EDPY 707.subject: EDPY
EDPY 707.title: Growth and Development: Middle Childhood and Adolescence

EDPY 708.description: Designed to further understanding of the adult and his/her endeavors in the learning process. Emphasis will be on the major contributing factors (physiological, psychological, and sociological) that affect the adult, on the relevant research findings, and on implications for educators.
EDPY 708.subject: EDPY
EDPY 708.title: Growth and Development: Adulthood

EDPY 741.description: A study of the cognitive processes involved in complex learning, conceptualization, problem-solving, abstract reasoning, and other aspects of higher intellectual functioning as developed and used in the educational setting.
EDPY 741.subject: EDPY
EDPY 741.title: Basic Processes: Cognition

EDPY 751.description: A systematic survey of major traditional and contemporary learning theories and principles relevant to the design and development of classroom teaching and instruction.
EDPY 751.subject: EDPY
EDPY 751.title: Learning and Instruction

EDPY 752.description: Analysis of concepts and methodological approaches to research in the Educational Psychology field. Focus on critical reading and evaluation of published literature across a broad spectrum of areas.
EDPY 752.subject: EDPY
EDPY 752.title: Research Methods in Educational Psychology

EDPY 805.description: Issues in research on human development with applications to educational settings.
EDPY 805.subject: EDPY
EDPY 805.title: Contemporary Research in Human Development and Education

EDPY 835.description: Advanced study of educational psychology with special emphasis on learning.
EDPY 835.subject: EDPY
EDPY 835.title: Educational Psychology

EDPY 873.description: Advanced problems in educational psychology as they apply to the public schools at all levels. Designed to meet the needs of candidates for graduate degrees.
EDPY 873.subject: EDPY
EDPY 873.title: Advanced Problems in Educational Psychology
